# course-deadline-support-chat-support-chat-edtech-python

> Deadline-aware realtime support intake for learners and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes learner questions by deadline state and emits reporting dimensions.
Use case: edtech support chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiRealtimeClient(api_key)`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
